{{Quote|It's her. It's the girl. Just tell us where he is.|The spicerunner trying to apprehend Princess Leia|<ref name="P2" />}}
A '''spicerunner''' tried to apprehend young [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] at the [[Daiyu marketplace]], in an attempt to get her to reveal the location of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and claim the [[bounty]] on him. However, they were quickly shot down by Kenobi, who was trying to protect the girl.<ref name="P2">{{Kenobi|Part II}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Obi-Wan Kenobi episode102-Im so humbled and honored to have had the opportunity to be one of the Spice Runners in Part 2.|Mackensi Emory on Instagram|<ref name="Instagram">{{Instagram|username=mackensi_emory|url=p/CeoXvMcFLPw|name=[[Mackensi Emory]]|date=2022-06-10|quote=Obi-Wan Kenobi episode102-Im so humbled and honored to have had the opportunity to be one of the Spice Runners in Part 2.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/oEKXO}}</ref>}}
The spicerunner appeared in the [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] episode "[[Part II]]," where they were played by stunt performer and martial artist<ref name="Occupation">{{OfficialSite|url=https://www.mackensiemory.com|text=Official Site of Mackensi Emory|quote=Stunt Performer - Martial Artist - Tricker|archivedate=2022-06-24|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/gcmFN}}</ref> [[Mackensi Emory]].<ref name="Instagram" /> In the episode credits, the character is listed as "Spice Runner #1".<ref name="P2" />
